title: Online local learning for generative thermodynamic computing
abstract: arXiv:2609.15439v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative thermodynamic computers turn thermal noise into structured data through Langevin dynamics. We train these systems with a local update at each integration step. The reverse-path Onsager-Machlup objective yields a coupling gradient that is a symmetric sum of local residual-state correlations. We apply this gradient immediately rather than accumulating it over a full trajectory. In digital simulations using MNIST prototypes, online and trajectory-batch training reach similar validation losses on fixed noising paths. Models trained online release less heat on average in all five independently seeded pairs, with both models' parameters held fixed during sampling. Auxiliary classifier and nearest-prototype measures change modestly, while pairwise diversity decreases. translated_title: 面向生成式热力学计算的在线局部学习
translated_abstract: 生成式热力学计算机通过朗之万动力学将热噪声转化为结构化数据。我们在每个积分步骤使用局部更新来训练这些系统。反向路径的Onsager-Machlup目标产生一个耦合梯度，该梯度是局部残差状态相关性的对称和。我们立即应用该梯度，而不是在整个轨迹上进行累积。在使用MNIST原型的数字仿真中，在固定加噪路径上，在线训练和轨迹批量训练达到了相近的验证损失。在采样期间两个模型的参数保持固定的条件下，在所有五个独立随机种子配对中，在线训练的模型平均释放更少的热量。辅助分类器和最近原型指标变化不大，而成对多样性有所下降。系统对噪声的响应强烈依赖于误差进入的位置：在形成的更新中引入的独立零均值误差在有限范围内产生的热量变化很小。
tldr: 本文提出一种用于生成式热力学计算的在线局部学习方法，在每个积分步骤即时应用基于Onsager-Machlup目标的局部耦合梯度更新，在达到与整条轨迹批量训练相当的验证损失的同时，平均释放更少的热量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an online local learning method for generative thermodynamic computing that applies Onsager-Machlup-based local coupling gradients immediately at each integration step, achieving validation losses comparable to trajectory-batch training while releasing less heat on average.
